description: Move to the next workspace when the active workspace IS the last one on the focused monitor and creating empty workspaces ahead is allowed. In this situation the operation returns the smallest workspace id strictly greater than the active id that is not currently occupied on any monitor. Occupied ids immediately above the active id are skipped one by one until the first free id is found, so a gap between occupied workspaces is filled. If every id above is occupied right up to the largest representable id, the first free slot encountered (including that largest id itself, when unoccupied) is returned. The direction selector requests the next workspace.
